caption: Brazilian kids dance-pop with a punchy driving beat, strong kick drum and snare, funky baile-inspired groove (clean and family-friendly), deep round bass, crisp hand claps, extremely catchy sing-along hook, warm friendly adult vocal with an energetic kids choir answering, bright and playful, polished studio-quality mix, the hook starts right on the first beat with no intro, every section lasts exactly 4 bars, short repeated chorus, simple melody in small steps, the last chorus goes up by a whole step (key change), clear Portuguese pronunciation of every word, bouncy funk-pop groove, stomping kick and claps on every beat, synth stabs, round 808 bass, bright glockenspiel hook
lyrics:
[Chorus]
Pé, pé, bate o pezinho,
pá, pá, com muito carinho,
gira, gira, devagarinho,
dança com o seu amiguinho!

[Verse 1]
Um pezinho vai pra frente,
outro pezinho vai pra trás,
todo mundo está contente,
dançando e pedindo mais!

[Chorus]

dança, dança, sem parar,
bate o pé, bate o pé,
vem comigo, vem dançar!

[Bridge]
Pé, pé, pá, pá,
todo mundo vai dançar,
pé, pé, pá, pá,
